<thought>We need the template ID for the amide‑formation (carboxylic‑acid + amine → amide) step applied to the target molecule. The valid functional‑group name for a broken carboxylic acid is “aliphatic carboxylic acid”. We'll search the template catalog with that name.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
